message.content: Keep the 12th. I usually finish by 6:30. Book it at that Italian place in Kreuzberg.

content.text: Done. Table for two at 7:30 PM on April 12th. I've also sent a reminder to your calendar for your yoga session with Maria Gonzalez this Wednesday. Do you want to keep it as is, or switch to the evening slot since you have that client call on Thursday morning?

I recommend the local shop to support Berlin small businesses and save the assembly hassle. Shall I proceed with the local order?

message.content: Yes, go ahead. And send the invoice to my expense report for Q2.
